speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash along with numbness and tingling on your palms. To understand the full picture, have you noticed any specific patterns to the rash, such as it appearing on knuckles, wrists, or elbows, and does it worsen with sun exposure? Additionally, have you experienced joint pain, muscle weakness, or any respiratory symptoms recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of a pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face, upper body), sensory neuropathy (numbness/tingling), and risk factors including rice farming (aristolochic acid exposure or arsenic) and livestock contact strongly suggests PCT.
